intent: Android Agent crash logs can be captured from another Windows PC with the current collector code on every manual launcher run.
rollback: Remove the local diagnostic script; no installed application, device setting or service data is changed.

requestReview.reason: The manually launched local launcher downloads the current collector script once per explicit run, and the collector downloads official Platform-Tools once only when adb.exe is absent; it does not access Firebase or add background app traffic.
requestReview.assumptions: One operator on one Windows PC launches the launcher once. Each manual launch reads one GitHub-hosted collector script; if ADB is absent, it reads one additional Google-hosted ZIP. There are zero remote writes, timers, listeners, automatic retries or app service requests.

checks.idle: The collector has no scheduled task, timer, listener or background process; no launch means zero requests.
checks.rerender: The collector has no UI lifecycle or remount path; each explicit launch is counted as one client launch.
checks.concurrency: The launcher and collector each perform one synchronous download at most per manual launch and share no running service; concurrent manual launches may each download and are outside the one-operator budget.
checks.failure: Download failures terminate and leave the console open; no retry loop is present.
checks.cleanup: The downloaded ZIP is removed after successful extraction, while extracted adb.exe is retained for future runs.

outcomes.acceptance: PC Viewer Connect while Android Agent is in background does not terminate the Agent; consent and approved first-frame delivery remain available.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-06: focused Android native release, discovery and packaging tests passed 12 tests; focused Agent/Add-On test and compilation passed. Signed Android 0.1.83 Agent, Viewer and Control Add-On release build passed with WebRTC JNI mapping verification, signature verification and generated update metadata. Firebase Hosting publishes android-update.json versionCode 1083. GitHub Actions run 33985944437 passed and published v0.1.83 x86 Viewer/Agent installers plus signed update manifest. Download aliases redirect to the current release assets.
outcomes.physicalGap: Reproduce reported crash with logcat on affected device, then verify signed optimized APK background request, permission refusal, approval, first frame, disconnect and repeated connection on arm64/armv7.

outcomes.acceptance: On another Windows PC, an operator can double-click one launcher file; every explicit run retrieves the current collector code, then finds a complete existing ADB path or reports an actionable USB debugging state before capturing the two Viewer connection attempts into a ZIP.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-06: PowerShell collector self-test verifies a full authorized device serial is accepted and an unauthorized device is rejected without a null value method call. npx vitest run src/androidCrashLogCollector.test.ts passed 3 tests, including deletion of a prior temporary collector and visible stop on current-download failure.
outcomes.physicalGap: Requires the affected Android device connected to a separate Windows PC with USB debugging authorized; run the capture through both connection attempts and provide the generated ZIP.
